title: rhodocalyx coccineus
intro: Rhodocalyx coccineus, commonly known as the scarlet crassula, is a succulent plant species belonging to the family Crassulaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rhodocalyx coccineus include treating wounds, reducing oxidative stress, and fighting against various microorganisms. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
